title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025, Natürliche Personen, Kantons-, Gemeinde-, direkte Bundessteuer
why_needed: Main guide for the 2025 return of natural persons: every Ziffer of the forms, deductions, worked example, rental value rates and the tariffs.
notes: 64 pages, form code 930109, main edition (HA). PDF created 2025-11-05, modified 2026-03-30. Names eSteuern.lu.ch as the online channel and the Scan-Center address for paper. Contains a filled example of the forms (Steuererklärung, B, WV, S/V, L), since the forms themselves cannot be downloaded.

title: Informationen zur Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Two-page sheet sent with the 2025 return: what changed for 2025, filing options, scanning rules, payment and limited tax liability.
notes: Form 930099 Ausgabe A, 2 pages, PDF created 2025-10-27. Lists the 2025 changes (cold progression, StG revision 2025 with a new degressive social deduction, life annuities taxed by income share). A print layout of the same sheet is at Steuerformulare/2025/Merkblatt_2025_A_Information_zur_Steuererklrung_Druck.pdf.

title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2026, Natürliche Personen (unterjährige Steuerpflicht)
why_needed: Only 2026 guide published so far; meant for tax liability that ends during 2026 (death, emigration), but it is a full guide with 2026 amounts.
notes: 64 pages, form code 930109, edition VA. The forms page lists it as Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung (unterjährige Steuerpflicht), PDF only. Gives the 2026 extension maxima (31 August and 30 November 2027). The regular 2026 guide is not published as of 2026-10-13.

title: Unterjährige Steuerpflicht 2026
why_needed: Explains returns for a tax liability that starts or ends during 2026 (moving abroad, death), including pro rata deductions and rate conversion.
notes: 2 pages, PDF created 2025-10-06. Recommends filing the unterjährige 2026 return through eSteuern.lu.ch.

title: eSteuern.lu.ch: Ihre neue Online-Lösung zum Ausfüllen der Steuererklärung
why_needed: Official how-to for eSteuern.LU, the web filing channel for tax year 2025: account, PersID and access code, import, submission and correction window.
notes: Form 930600, 2 pages, PDF created 2025-10-27. Account needs an e-mail address and a mobile phone. A return is opened with the PersID and the Zugangscode eFiling printed on the return. Imports the 2024 file (.lunp2024) and bank e-tax statements. After submission there are 72 hours to correct and resubmit.

title: Deklaration
why_needed: Official entry page to eSteuern.LU (Online-Steuererklärung 2025) and to the 2024 backup desktop software.
notes: Links https://esteuern.lu.ch/ (a JavaScript web app whose page metadata names it eTax LU). The 2024 backup software for Windows, macOS and Linux downloads from webupdate.ringler.ch; the page says the 2024 return can now only be filed on paper.

title: Steuererklärung erstmals komplett digital ausfüllen
why_needed: Press release announcing eSteuern.LU for tax year 2025: launch date, login method, data import, paper still allowed.
notes: Mitteilung of 15 January 2026. eSteuern.LU online from 26 January 2026, replaces the downloadable software, is a standard solution used in many cantons, login with e-mail address and mobile number, data stored in the canton infrastructure, paper filing still possible.

title: Ergänzungsblatt Direkte Bundessteuer 2025
why_needed: Converts the cantonal net income to the federal one (commuting cap, insurance deduction, rental value reduction, qualified holdings).
notes: 1 page, fillable (rechenbar), modified 2026-01-26. Form F14 on the order page. The federal amounts are printed on the form.

title: Bestellservice für Steuerformulare
why_needed: Lists every 2025 and 2026 form with its order code and says which ones can be downloaded.
notes: The scanning forms (Steuererklärung F4, Wertschriftenverzeichnis F5, Berufsauslagen B F8, Krankheitskosten K F9, Unterhalt/Fremdbetreuung U/F F10, Schulden/Versicherung S/V F11, Liegenschaften L F12, F13) are only available printed or inside the software; they cannot be downloaded.

title: Abzüge 2025 auf einen Blick
why_needed: One-page table of the 2025 deductions by form Ziffer, canton versus federal: commuting, meals, other professional costs, 3a, insurance, childcare, children, social deductions.
notes: 1 page, printed Version vom 22.10.2024. Includes the degressive social deduction formula and the wealth tax-free amounts.

title: Abzüge 2026 auf einen Blick
why_needed: Same table for tax year 2026.
notes: 1 page, printed Version vom 21.01.2026. The car mileage rate and indexed amounts differ from 2025.

title: Luzerner Steuerbuch Band 1 (Stand 01.01.2025)
why_needed: Official practice directives (Weisungen) on tax liability, income, deductions, wealth and tax computation as of 1 January 2025.
notes: 246 pages, PDF modified 2025-01-16. Archive PDF of Band 1. Covers § 33 Nr. 1 to 3 (Fahrkosten, Verpflegung, übrige Berufskosten), § 40 (3a, insurance, medical costs, donations, training, second earner), § 42 (children, childcare, degressive social deduction), § 57 Nr. 1 (Familientarif), § 60 (wealth tariff).

title: Luzerner Steuerbuch Band 1 (Stand 01.01.2026)
why_needed: Same directives as of 1 January 2026; the live chapters at steuerbuch.lu.ch/band1 show the validity date of each.
notes: 251 pages, PDF created 2026-01-12; the newsletter of 13 January 2026 announced the 2026 updates. Several chapters changed on 1 January 2026 (Fahrkosten, übrige Berufskosten, Versicherungsprämien, Kinderabzug, Kinderbetreuungsabzug, degressiver Sozialabzug).

title: Tariftabellen 2025 und Abzüge 2025
why_needed: Income tariff brackets per unit for single persons (§ 57 Abs. 1 StG) and families (§ 57 Abs. 2) for 2025, plus the indexed deductions.
notes: 2 pages, dated 16.10.2024 on the page. The tariff gives the tax per unit (Steuer je Einheit); the total tax is that amount times the sum of state, commune and church units.

title: Tariftabellen 2026 und Abzüge 2026
why_needed: Same for tax year 2026 (after the cold progression adjustment).
notes: 2 pages, dated 17.09.2025 on the page. Includes the table of deductions with origin index and 2026 values.

title: Berechnungstabelle zu § 57 des Steuergesetzes (SRL Nr. 620) 2025
why_needed: Precomputed tax per unit for every 100 francs of taxable income, single and family tariff, 2025: a test oracle for the tariff code.
notes: 402 pages, generated from a spreadsheet, PDF created 2024-10-18.

title: Berechnungstabelle zu § 57 des Steuergesetzes (SRL Nr. 620) 2026
why_needed: Same precomputed table for 2026.
notes: 402 pages, PDF created 2025-11-06.

title: Berechnungstabellen Steuertarife
why_needed: Index of all income tariff tables by year and the wealth tax rule per unit with a worked example.
notes: Already lists the 2027 tariff tables (Tariftabellen und Abzüge 2027, Einkommenssteuertarife 2027). Wealth tax per unit is stated here and in StG § 60.

title: Steuereinheiten 2025, Staat / Einwohner- und Kirchgemeinde
why_needed: State units and the units of every commune and its Roman Catholic, Reformed and Christ Catholic parish for 2025, with totals.
notes: 2 pages, alphabetical by commune, printout dated 10.04.2025. Natural persons table.

title: Steuereinheiten 2026, Staat / Einwohner- und Kirchgemeinde
why_needed: Same table for 2026.
notes: 2 pages, printout dated 24.03.2026. The state units changed between 2025 and 2026; read both tables.

title: Steuereinheiten / Tarife
why_needed: Index of the units tables 2003 to 2026 and the history of the state units (Staatssteuereinheiten).
notes: Also links a per commune ranking (Rangfolge) and the legal persons tables. No 2027 units yet.

title: Steuergesetz (StG), SRL Nr. 620, Stand 1. Juni 2025
why_needed: Cantonal tax law version in force from 1 June to 31 December 2025: tariffs (§ 57), wealth tariff (§ 60), maximum burden (§ 62), deductions (§§ 33, 40, 42), procedure.
notes: 123 pages. Version id 4405. Version 4359 covered 1 January to 31 May 2025. Still has the old flat rule for life annuities, see NOTES.

title: Steuergesetz (StG), SRL Nr. 620, Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: Version in force from 1 January to 30 September 2026, with the 2026 indexed tariffs and deductions in § 57 and § 42.
notes: 123 pages. Version id 4667. The current consolidated version (id 4903, Stand 1. Oktober 2026) already shows the amendment of 11 May 2026 that mostly enters into force on 1 January 2027.

title: Steuerverordnung (StV), SRL Nr. 621, Stand 1. Januar 2025
why_needed: Ordinance for 2025: professional costs follow the federal ordinance (§ 11), medical costs (§ 12), childcare (§ 14b), debts, interest on prepayments.
notes: 22 pages. Version id 4354.

title: Steuerverordnung (StV), SRL Nr. 621, Stand 1. Januar 2026
why_needed: Ordinance version in force since 1 January 2026.
notes: 22 pages. Version id 4586, current as of 2026-10-13.

title: Verordnung über die Quellensteuer (QStV), SRL Nr. 624, Stand 1. Januar 2021
why_needed: Cantonal source tax ordinance: who must file a return, NOV conditions, rectification.
notes: 12 pages. Version id 3670, current as of 2026-10-13.

title: Quellensteuer Tarif AY und BY mit Kirchensteuer 2025
why_needed: Monthly source tax rates 2025 for single (A0Y) and married (B0Y to B5Y) employees with church tax.
notes: 13 pages, PDF created 2024-10-31. Header reads Tarif AY und BY mit Kirchensteuer 2025, Monatstarif.

title: Quellensteuer Tarif AN und BN ohne Kirchensteuer 2025
why_needed: Same tables 2025 without church tax (A0N, B0N to B5N).
notes: 13 pages, PDF created 2024-10-31.

title: Quellensteuer Tarif AY und BY mit Kirchensteuer 2026
why_needed: Monthly source tax rates valid from 1 January 2026 for tariffs A and B with church tax.
notes: 13 pages, PDF created 2025-11-28. Header reads Tarif AY und BY mit Kirchensteuer 2026. The information letter QS_Tarifschreiben_2026.pdf says the tariffs were adjusted on 1 January 2026.

title: Quellensteuer Tarif AN und BN ohne Kirchensteuer 2026
why_needed: Same tables 2026 without church tax.
notes: 13 pages, PDF created 2025-11-28.

title: Quellensteuer Tarife Kanton Luzern
why_needed: Index of the 2025 and 2026 source tax tables: A and B, C, G, H (with and without church tax), pension lump sums, payroll text files.
notes: Also links the 2026 flat deductions workbook (Quellensteuer_Pauschalabzge_Tarife_2026.xlsx) and the tar25LU / 2026 text files for payroll software.

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV)
why_needed: When NOV is mandatory or can be requested, the 31 March deadline, irrevocability, crediting of source tax, documents to attach.
notes: Form 930498, 2 pages, PDF created 2025-05-14. Says a filed request cannot be withdrawn and that leaving Switzerland ends the request period at deregistration.

title: Steuererklärung (NOV)
why_needed: How to request NOV: online request, window from December to 31 March of the following year, what happens next.
notes: The request itself is an online form at formular.lu.ch (JavaScript), not a downloadable document; see NOTES gaps.

title: Neuberechnung Quellensteuer
why_needed: Rectification of the source tax deduction (wrong gross salary, rate-determining income or tariff) and its deadline.
notes: Deadline 31 March of the year after the payment; request by e-mail to dst.qs@lu.ch or by post with evidence. Refers to ESTV Kreisschreiben 45.

title: Luzerner Steuerbuch Band 2 (Stand 01.01.2026)
why_needed: Directives on source tax and procedure: PC forms and barcode rules for third-party software (§ 145 Nr. 1), eFiling (§ 145 Nr. 1a), filing deadline and extensions (§ 145 Nr. 2), reminders (§ 145 Nr. 3), NOV (§ 152 Nr. 2).
notes: 180 pages. The procedure chapters carry validity date 01.01.2024 and predate eSteuern.LU (eFiling chapter still names the downloadable software and a 120 hour correction window); see NOTES.
